title: Registered with the State after the City had begun to pay
question: Which City-funded charities first registered with the Attorney General after one or more full fiscal years of City payments, and which had to be told to register?
finding: 4 organizations registered only after at least one full fiscal year of City payments, $13.6 million in those earlier years: The SF Housing Accelerator Fund (registered 3 May 2021, $10.0 million before); SF New Deal (registered 11 February 2021, $2.5 million before); Excelsior Action Group (registered 16 September 2021, $626,555 before); Southeast Consortium For Equitable Partn (registered 25 September 2019, $423,848 before). 3 were sent a notice to register by the registry.
how: Registration date is the registry's "initial registration" for records numbered CT (issued since 2007). First payment is the first City fiscal year with a payment in the payment file, which begins in fiscal 2017. "Paid before" counts only fiscal years that had ended before the registration date. Notices to register are taken from the registry's document list; the letters themselves were not downloaded.
limits: Older records with six-digit numbers carry converted dates and are left out, so this covers only organizations registered since 2007. An organization may have worked under a fiscal sponsor that was registered, or under an earlier registration the search did not return; the employer number on the filings shows the same legal body was paid, not that it was soliciting donations in those years. Late registration is curable and the registry shows these records as registered today.
